Return F for any concrete unresolved material defect supported by the supplied evidence. Do not treat unavailable external Google OAuth credentials as a code defect when access fails closed. Output schema JSON only.

Media Factory V10 authorization hotfix for exact SHA 23fe76e9b1c1751ab08ccca92598e49587f627f1, parent 662c5dbde18df3fa3637d317a3e399429510a856. The parent is currently deployed. Independent review found three material authorization gaps in the parent: (1) inviting the stored email of a previously known Google user could grant a new tenant membership without a fresh Google identity verification, (2) the product/UI only exposed reviewer and admin invitation mappings while the approved V10 scope requires reviewer/admin/editor/viewer, and (3) team mutation authorization was checked before rather than inside the repository transaction, creating a revocation TOCTOU window.

The hotfix centralizes team mutation authority in server/team-access.mjs. Every invitation remains PENDING until a fresh Google callback verifies the email. The immutable Google provider subject remains the identity anchor. Pending invitations never overwrite an existing membership. Role input is an explicit own-property allowlist for municipal_coordinator->reviewer, it->admin, editor->editor and viewer->viewer; owner cannot be assigned through this surface. Local administrative identities and owners remain protected. update/remove revoke matching stale pending invitations. owner/admin authority is resolved again against the same repository snapshot inside each transaction. Google sessions can resolve against that transactional snapshot. The existing encrypted GoogleAuthVault remains authoritative; no plaintext replacement was introduced.

OIDC verification is additionally hardened: bounded JSON reads, strict compact JWT syntax, RS256/JWK constraints, aud/azp/exp/iat/nbf validation and controlled JWKS refresh after key rotation. The production login repair from parent 662c5db remains intact: Google availability is server-rendered, while the Google configuration API stays private. The Team UI exposes the four non-owner roles and, after registering an invitation, states that no email was sent and provides a shareable /login link.

Exact SHA validation: TypeScript PASS; production build PASS; contracts 13/13 PASS; production audit no known vulnerabilities; focused suite 46/46 PASS; V10 authorization suite 19/19 PASS; full serial suite 217 discovered / 216 PASS / 0 FAIL / 1 pre-existing SKIP; exact clean browser E2E PASS; exact clean non-test FIRMES completion PASS with 1080x1920 8-second artifact; detached verifier build/typecheck/contracts/audit + 46/46 PASS. No new npm dependency. Two existing Turbopack dynamic filesystem tracing warnings remain unchanged. A real Google OAuth Web client has not been supplied, so no live Google-account smoke is claimed; product remains fail-closed until owner configures the client and exact HTTPS callback.
